page_title: BET 1-1 SEV | Betis v Sevilla 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.

90+4' The referee blows his whistle for unsporting behaviour, with Johnny Cardoso (Betis) the culprit. Johnny Cardoso (Betis) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+4' Kike Salas (Sevilla) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Nabil Fekir (Betis) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. Chadi Riad (Betis) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
90+2' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Betis have a free kick.
90+1' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) brings an opponent down and Jose Sanchez interrupts the game. Betis have a free kick.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Loic Bade (Sevilla) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he arrows his header just a few inches wide of the right post.
89' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Sevilla will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

87' Crossbar! Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from around the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the bar!
86' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
85' A substitution has been made. Dodi Lukebakio goes off and Erik Lamela (Sevilla) comes on.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch so that Lucas Ocampos can be given a rest.
83' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Ayoze Perez will be replaced by Rodri (Betis).
83' Isco comes off the pitch to be replaced by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis).
82' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) makes a good run to latch onto the free kick from Nabil Fekir, but pushes his close-range header well past the left post.
81' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) is booked.
80' Isco (Betis) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Orjan Nyland makes a great save to stop his effort.
78' Marcos Acuna pings in the corner towards the centre of the box and finds Loic Bade (Sevilla) unmarked, but his free header is woeful and slips well over the bar.
78' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
77' Suso (Sevilla) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

77' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and Sevilla manage to earn a corner.
76' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
74' The referee is firm and issues Suso (Sevilla) a deserved yellow card. Suso (Sevilla) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
74' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Marcos Acuna (Sevilla), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
73' Here comes a substitution. Nabil Fekir (Betis) is brought on as a substitute for Pablo Fornals.
72' Referee Jose Sanchez sees the trip by Pablo Fornals (Betis) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Sevilla are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
70' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Isco (Betis) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
69' Isco (Betis) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

69' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Betis.
69' An attempted cross from Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) is cleared.
67' Ayoze Perez (Betis) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
66' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) fails to trouble the keeper from distance as his shot goes well wide of the right post.
64' Juan Miranda (Betis) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
62' Juan Miranda (Betis) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
61' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

61' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Jose Sanchez changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement. Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Jose Sanchez decides there was no infringement by Loic Bade (Sevilla) and the game can continue.
59' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
59' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Loic Bade (Sevilla).

58' Loic Bade (Sevilla) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Sanchez no option but to blow his whistle. The referee makes the call - penalty to Betis!

56' 1 - 1 Kike Salas (Sevilla) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Marcos Acuna. His header was precise and ended up inside the left post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:1.
56' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
54' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) cracks a volley from just outside the box and his bad shot goes way wide of the right post. It will be a goal kick.
54' Isco (Betis) works the corner short.
54' Quique Sanchez Flores is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Jesus Navas (Sevilla) suffers an injury and Kike Salas comes on.

52' Ayoze Perez (Betis) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Orjan Nyland anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the left side of the target.
52' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
50' Cedric Bakambu is substituted due to injury. Manuel Pellegrini gives a chance to Willian Jose (Betis).
50' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
50' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
49' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but unbelievably sends his shot wide of the right post.
48' The attendance for today's match is 55770.
46' Referee Jose Sanchez blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+4' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
45+3' Suso (Sevilla) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45+3' Suso (Sevilla) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. Sevilla win a corner.

45+3' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) unleashes a close-range volley towards the bottom left corner, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains unchanged.
40' Isco (Betis) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
40' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) tries to find Youssef En Nesyri with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
38' 1 - 0 Goal! Orjan Nyland gets a hand on the penalty from Isco (Betis), but can't stop it from flying inside the left post.
37' Isco (Betis) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
36' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla). That's a penalty to Betis! They have a good chance to score now.
36' Pablo Fornals (Betis) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.

35' Pablo Fornals (Betis) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the left side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
35' 2:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.
30' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
30' Orjan Nyland stretches to his right and makes a brilliant save! Johnny Cardoso (Betis) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper inside the left post.
30' Ayoze Perez (Betis) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
29' Dodi Lukebakio has a look up and finds Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) in space. He wastes no time in trying to test the keeper from distance but the shot is just wide of the left post.
27' Ayoze Perez (Betis) is penalised for a foul. Jose Sanchez had a clear view and blows his whistle.
25' Isco (Betis) sends a long cross over to Pablo Fornals, but Orjan Nyland comes forward to gather the ball.
24' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
23' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
20' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Guido Rodriguez (Betis) offside.
19' The free kick is taken by Isco (Betis), but ball is cleared.
18' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle after Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a free kick to Betis in a dangerous position.
16' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
15' Quique Sanchez Flores is forced to make a change. Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Dodi Lukebakio.
14' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
13' The game is interrupted now, Isaac Romero (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
12' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
10' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
8' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Rui Silva, who smothers the ball.
7' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
6' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Pablo Fornals (Betis) for his blatant foul.
5' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) leaps to meet the corner from Isco, but plants his header a whisker wide of the right post from close range.
5' Isco (Betis) prepares to take a corner kick.
4' Ayoze Perez (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Betis force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
2' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
2' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Betis will kick-off.
Jose Sanchez is the one to supervise the game today.
